title: Smoked Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender lamb skewers marinated in a smoky blend of spices and grilled to perfection. Perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: preferably with the fat still intact

ingredients.name: Smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice depth of flavor

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the kebab spice blend, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, lemon juice, and salt.
Add the lamb pieces to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the lamb pieces onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a salad.
